живой.en: Don't you dare kill the spider! He’s a living creature!

живой.en: There's live music in this restaurant on weekends.

живой.en: Living creatures can’t live without water.

живот.en: He clutched his stomach in pain.

живот.en: He complained of pain in his stomach.

жидкий.en: Wet mud sloshed under my feet.

жидкий.en: In the morning, I drank a cup of cheap weak coffee.

жизнерадостный.en: I've never seen Katya in such a good mood.

жизнь.en: He has worked at school all his life.

жилой.en: The mayor of the city allocated money for repair of the residential building.

жилой.en: In legal documents, an apartment is often called a living space.

жилой.en: The construction of high-rise apartment buildings is currently expanding.

жир.en: Do you know how to clean away grease from a gas stovetop?

жир.en: Fish oil contains vitamins and healthy fatty acids.

жирный.en: Your hands are greasy, wipe them off with a napkin.

жирный.en: I don't like food that is too greasy.

житель.en: The people of Moscow liked the new metro station.

жительница.en: I talked to the locals and found out where the most delicious pizza is.

жительница.en: A citizen from the capital was shocked by the local customs.
